title: LabTrust Evidence Bundle Manifest v0.1
description: Manifest for EvidenceBundle.v0.1: files with sha256, policy_fingerprint, optional signature.

tool_registry_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest of tool registry (B010); policy_fingerprint may incorporate this.

coordination_audit_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical digest (step_id, proposal_hash, shield_outcome_hash) from episode log for verification.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature: algorithm, public_key_b64, signature_b64, key_id

reconstruction.description: PCS release reconstruction provenance (LTG-PR6): digests and identity for independent offline verify.

policy_digest.description: Policy digest (typically equals policy_fingerprint on this manifest)

environment_digest.description: SHA-256 binding environment family/version, obs/action schemas, and policy fingerprints

agent_identity.description: Agent baseline or plugin identity (e.g. agent_baseline_id)

seed.description: Primary episode or base seed for reconstruction

scenario_ids.description: Task / golden scenario IDs covered by this bundle

risk_register_refs.description: Relative paths or IDs linking to risk register evidence

verification_results.description: Links/commands for offline verification (not a post-hoc stamp that mutates hashes)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit missing-evidence declarations (often empty on a single bundle)

policy_digest.description: Alias of policy_fingerprint for reconstruction field checklist; prefer reconstruction.policy_digest

environment_digest.description: Top-level mirror of reconstruction.environment_digest for pack scanners
